title.zh: 多人 XR 无人机游戏

context.zh: 魏允瀚独立完成的研究工程项目，接受导师与实验室支持
context.en: Individual research engineering project completed by Yunhan Wei with faculty and lab support

summary.zh: 在 Unity 中开发多人 XR 无人机游戏原型，将 ZED 相机追踪空间映射至共享虚拟坐标，并通过 Photon PUN 同步校准结果与多人游戏状态。
summary.en: A multiplayer XR drone-game prototype in Unity that maps ZED camera tracking into shared virtual coordinates and synchronizes calibration and gameplay state through Photon PUN.

zh: 让多名玩家在同一物理空间中共享一致的虚拟坐标
将空间校准融入可操作的无人机游戏循环
en: Give multiple players a consistent shared virtual coordinate frame
Integrate spatial calibration into a playable drone-game loop

zh: 主机权威校准快照同步
使用稳健多锚点拟合降低异常标定点的影响
由主机发布统一校准快照，减少客户端坐标分歧
en: Use robust multi-anchor fitting to reduce the impact of outlier calibration points
Have the host publish a shared calibration snapshot to reduce client coordinate divergence

zh: 加入在线校准修正以改善运行过程中的空间一致性
实体无人机尚未稳定运行，当前原型以 ZED 相机完成核心体验验证
en: Added online calibration refinement to improve spatial consistency during play
Physical drones were not yet reliable, so the current prototype validates the core experience with the ZED camera

zh: 使用 Unity、C#、ZED SDK 与 Photon PUN 开发多人 XR 无人机游戏原型，实现真实空间到共享虚拟坐标的尺度、偏航与地面校准。
设计稳健多锚点拟合、在线修正与主机权威校准快照同步，降低异常锚点及多客户端坐标偏差对体验的影响。
en: Developed a multiplayer XR drone-game prototype with Unity, C#, ZED SDK, and Photon PUN, including scale, yaw, and floor calibration from physical space to a shared virtual frame.
Designed robust multi-anchor fitting, online refinement, and host-authoritative calibration snapshots to reduce outlier and cross-client coordinate errors.

website.zh: 该原型探索如何让多名玩家在同一真实空间内共享一致的 XR 无人机体验。系统通过 ZED 相机获取空间追踪数据，完成尺度、偏航与地面校准，并由 Photon PUN 同步统一校准结果和多人状态。
website.en: This prototype explores how multiple players can share a consistent XR drone experience in one physical space. ZED tracking drives scale, yaw, and floor calibration, while Photon PUN distributes a shared calibration result and multiplayer state.

full.zh: 项目在 Unity 中建立从 ZED 相机追踪空间到共享虚拟世界的校准流程。除基础尺度、偏航和真实地面锚定外，系统使用稳健多锚点相似变换拟合与在线修正提高空间一致性，并通过主机权威快照向各客户端同步校准状态。当前成果为可玩的相机驱动原型；实体无人机集成仍是后续工作。
full.en: The project builds a calibration pipeline from ZED camera tracking space into a shared Unity world. Beyond scale, yaw, and real-floor anchoring, it uses robust multi-anchor similarity fitting and online refinement for consistency, then distributes calibration state through host-authoritative snapshots. The current result is a playable camera-driven prototype; physical-drone integration remains future work.
